artworks.title: Matinée d'Hiver sur les Quais (Winter Morning on the Quays)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint, and sandpaper ground in brown ink on japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban scene from a street-level viewpoint. The cityscape, buildings, industrial chimneys releasing smoke, and people and horse-drawn carriages are shown in fine lines and cross-hatching, creating a textured appearance. The color palette is primarily gray and brown. The scene conveys a somber and muted atmosphere.

artworks.title: La Traversee (The Passage)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, and soft-ground etching with graphite notations on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various scenes on a ship. The image consists of several detailed sketches depicting life aboard a vessel. The main section shows figures ascending a staircase under umbrellas, leading to an elevated platform with steam rising above. To the left, there is a blurred landscape with a figure and a dog. The lower sections contain smaller sketches: one of a group huddled together, and another resembling an interior scene with figures seated along benches. The overall composition provides a glimpse into life on a ship.

artworks.title: Le Peintre de Marine (The Marine Painter)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, sandpaper ground, and spit bite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a silhouette of a figure walking along a shore. The horizon is above the center, separating the dark sea and dramatic sky filled with swirling clouds and birds. The textured brushstrokes create movement and chaos. The palette is monochromatic with shades of black and gray, conveying a moody atmosphere. The water reflects the sky, blending into the dark shoreline shapes.

artworks.title: A Great Beech Tree at the Edge of a Wood
artworks.medium: black and white chalk with gray wash on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karen B. Cohen in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a prominent tree in the foreground. The horizon is near the base of the tree and there is a faint outline of a building behind it. The artwork features sketch-like brushstrokes, textured line work, and hints of watercolor washes for shading. The color palette is muted with gray and brown tones. In the background, there is a suggestion of a landscape beyond the tree's branches.

artworks.title: Le Crépuscule
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with trees, water, hills, and a star in the sky. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing the nature scene dominated by silhouettes of trees and a body of water. The horizon sits high, grazing the hilltops with a star or planet above. The trees are detailed, showing a dense network of branches and foliage with a dark, intricate texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black to depict the transition from light to dark. The water reflects the sky with gentle ripples, while shadows deepen around the trees. The hills in the distance blend softly into the encroaching night, while the brightening sky hints at evening approaching.

artworks.title: Flooding in the Forest of the Ile Séguin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karen B. Cohen in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with a forest path, trees, branches, foliage, and light filtering through the canopy. The artwork features dense, textured brushstrokes or etching, creating depth and intricate patterns. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing dark and light contrasts in the forest.

artworks.title: Flooding in the Forest of the Ile Séguin
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Karen B. Cohen in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woodland scene with towering trees and a distant horizon obscured by dense foliage. The intricate brushwork depicts details of foliage and tree bark in monochrome tones. Two figures are depicted in the scene, one standing near a path and another reclining against a tree in the distance. Light filters through the leaves, illuminating the scene.

artworks.title: Desdemona's Death-Song
artworks.medium: black chalk over traces of red chalk on two joined sheets of blue-green paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (frame size): 127 x 101.6 cm (50 x 40 in.)
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund and Paul Mellon Fund
artworks.description: One woman sits and bends forward, bracing her elbows on her wide-spread knees as a second woman combs her long hair in this vertical black chalk drawing on pale blue paper. Both have straight, strong noses, wide-set eyes, full, rounded lips, and pointed chins in thin faces. The seated woman’s knees are turned to our left, but she turns her head to look over our left shoulder with her lips parted. Her right arm extends almost straight so her hand lies limp beyond her right knee, and she holds an oval hand mirror tucked against her voluminous skirts in her other hand. The bodice and sleeves of her dress have been taken off, and they hang loosely around her waist. Her chemise has short, loose sleeves, and one bare foot peeks out from under her long skirt. A low table next to her shins, to our left, holds toiletries and bottles, and a bed set up on a platform separates her from the back wall of the room. She sits on the edge of the bed near the footboard. The second woman stands on the floor behind the bed and platform, reaching over the footboard to hold up the first woman’s hair with both hands. The second woman’s dress has long, puffy sleeves and a low, square-cut neckline. Her hair is pulled back under a twisted head band. She leans to one side, coming toward us, to look down at the seated woman from over one shoulder. A tree branch whips around the edge of a swirling curtain in the background to the left. To the right are a round shield and short sword, a lit candle in a tall candlestick, and a crucifix. An in scription in chalk in the top left corner of the drawing reads, “Desdemona’s Death-Song.” Along the bottom edge, more writing reads, “46 6/8 x 29 6/8 hanging sleeve more to side clear of dress.”

artworks.title: San Carlo Borromeo Giving Last Communion to Victims of the Plague
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce and Mary Hopkins Gibb Fund
artworks.description: The image features numerous figures in expressive poses, gathered under an archway. Several cherubic figures and draped fabric add texture to the scene. Light and shadow emphasize the figures' movements and gestures. The setting includes ornate columns and classical architecture.

artworks.title: Studies of Aurora and Apollo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, squared for transfer
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various mythical figures in a celestial scene. The composition shows intricate details of figures intertwined among clouds and drapery, in dynamic poses. Some figures have wings or swirling garments, creating a sense of movement and grandeur. They are distributed harmoniously throughout the drawing, interacting with celestial elements like clouds. The artwork features fine lines and shading for depth and texture. The drawing suggests a narrative or divine event, possibly intended as a preparatory sketch for a larger piece, such as a fresco or ceiling painting.

artworks.title: An Archer Shooting a Crossbow
artworks.artist: Attributed to Cherubino Alberti (formerly Cornelis Cort) after Lelio Orsi
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut inside platemark): 22.1 x 14 cm (8 11/16 x 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning forward and balancing on an architectural structure resembling an arch. They are posed with one leg bent and resting on the arch and the other leg stretched behind. The person appears to be handling a crossbow on their arm, their face obscured by their tilted head. They wear a cap with a small protrusion. The person is clad in a sleeveless garment with a waist belt, tights, and simple shoes. An arrow quiver on their back holds some arrows. The background is plain, highlighting the detailed figure and architectural base. The bottom of the image is marked with the date "1579" and the signature "Regij."

artworks.title: Alfred Stieglitz
artworks.creditLine: R. K. Mellon Family Foundation, Diana and Mallory Walker Fund, and Robert B. Menschel Fund

artworks.title: Bridge and tunnel over Jalon, Madrid to Zaragoza
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a railway bridge crossing over a gorge or river. A steam locomotive with carriages is on the bridge, with a person visible on the train. The metal truss bridge has intricate ironwork. The background consists of rugged hills, and a tunnel is visible at the far end of the bridge. The landscape features rocky terrain with diagonal lines formed by layers of stone. The color scheme is sepia-toned, giving the image an aged look. Vegetation is sparse in the distance. Piles of wooden planks and beams are scattered near the bridge.

artworks.title: The Caryatides
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The remains of a rectangular porch-like portico are photographed in tones of ash-brown and black in this horizontal albumen print. The roof of the portico is held up by six marble columns carved into the shape of women wearing robes that fall in long, vertical folds. The women all face forward, and some of their features are weathered. All are missing their arms. The portico and structure behind it are constructed with massive, squared blocks. A man wearing a suit and a bowler hat sits drawing in the corner where the portico meets the bulk of the building, near the lower right corner of the photograph. Fragments of reliefs and other architectural ornaments are lined up behind and next to him. A few scrubby plants grow on the dirt ground, and the sky above is a washed out white. White text angled up across the lower right corner reads, “D. CONSTANTIN.”

artworks.title: A Waterfall between Rocky Cliffs
artworks.medium: black chalk on a ledger paper lightly ruled with ink
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white etching of an outdoor scene with rocky terrain and cascading water. The view is slightly elevated, showcasing the water flowing down detailed rock formations. The horizon is not clearly visible, and the composition emphasizes the vertical elements of the rocks and water. Large rock faces frame the scene on the left and right, with foliage growing from their crevices. The intricate lines in the etching create texture on the rocks and leaves. The color scheme consists of gradients of black and white to depict depth and shadow. In the distance, more rocky terrain is visible, with sparse branches and leaves adding to the natural setting.

artworks.title: A Woodland Pond with a Hunter
artworks.medium: black chalk on a ledger page lightly ruled with ink
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low view by the water's edge. The horizon is low, and there are dense trees creating a silhouette against the sky. Trees cover the entire scene, with a prominent cluster in the middle and on the right. The detailing of the trees and foliage is captured through soft brushstrokes and pencil work. Birds are flying in the top left corner. By the water's edge, there are reeds, a fallen branch, a person, and a dog beneath a large tree on the right. The color scheme is monochromatic, using various shades of gray to depict light and shadow, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Willibald Pirckheimer
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 10.8 x 11.2 cm (4 1/4 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of C.G. Boerner, LLC
artworks.description: This image features a bust portrait of a man, depicted from the shoulders up in profile. The man has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, full lips, and deep-set eyes. His curly hair is styled in a voluminous manner, framing his face. He is wearing a garment with a fur-lined collar, and below the portrait is a rectangular frame with an inscription in Latin. The background of the image is plain.

artworks.title: Cupid Balancing on a Globe
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut inside platemark): 11.9 x 6.8 cm (4 11/16 x 2 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cherubic figure surrounded by mythical and earthly elements. The central figure is a large, winged, chubby child. They appear to be in a dynamic pose, stepping onto a spherical object with one foot and leaning on an elaborate structure with one hand. The figure has large, curly hair and wears a fabric draped over one shoulder. The intricate background includes twisted trees, columns, and various figures engaged in different activities below. The scene is filled with detailed line work and patterns, creating a rich tapestry of textures and shapes reminiscent of a detailed engraving. The elements suggest a scene rich in symbolism, common in Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Tower Struck by Lightning, Saint-Ouen Bay
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a solitary stone tower in a barren landscape. The horizon line is low in the composition, with gentle slopes and distant hills. The tower is weathered with rough textured stones, mortar lines, and some boarded-up windows. The photo is rendered in sepia tones, contrasting the tower against the sandy surroundings. The sky is pale, emphasizing the tower and creating a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Salon of the Caryatides, Louvre
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image features a grand hall with classical sculptures displayed on pedestals. The sculptures depict human figures and are positioned throughout the corridor. One sculpture shows a standing figure holding an object, potentially an instrument. The sculptures are made of marble or a similar light-colored stone. The hall has vaulted ceilings with decorative motifs and elegant columns, creating a serene atmosphere. The arrangement of sculptures in the space evokes a sense of historical grandeur.

artworks.title: Flooding in the Forest of the Ile Séguin
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a spectator in a dense forest, looking down a shaded path that leads deeper into the woods. The etching shows intricate, fine lines creating detail in the bark of the trees and foliage. The dense trees fill the scene, casting patterns of shadow and light. The trunks of the trees dominate the foreground, emphasizing the untamed nature of the setting. The path leads into a shadowed area in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of black and white, enhancing the contrasts between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Veüe Et perspective du Chateau de Chenonceaux
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Janet and David Bruce
artworks.description: The image shows the Château de Chenonceaux. The view is slightly elevated, capturing the castle and its surroundings. The horizon is low with trees, sky, and clouds. The brushwork is detailed. The color palette includes blues and earth tones. Figures are walking near the water, and boats are sailing in the distance. The landscape includes gardens and trees. The sky has various shades of blue and a floating banner.

artworks.title: The Mall from Saint James' Park
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Janet and David Bruce
artworks.description: The image shows a formal garden or park with elegantly dressed figures engaged in various activities. The horizon line is marked by distant architectural structures, including a tower and dome-topped buildings, against a blue sky with clouds. The painting features refined brushstrokes portraying textures in trees and clothing. The color palette consists of earth tones, pastels, and vivid blue tones. People gather near a path, with a man and cows, creating a pastoral scene. Stately trees line the path leading towards the distant buildings.

artworks.title: Madura: The Vygay River, with Causeway, across to Madura
artworks.creditLine: The Carolyn Brody Fund and Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a low angle view of a path lined with stone columns leading towards a distant structure. The path meets trees at the horizon line, with a temple-like building visible in the distance to the left. The sky is overcast with thin clouds, creating soft light. The image is in grayscale with varying tones. The ground is uneven with scattered puddles, while trees and structures convey depth towards the distant architectural elements.
